The '''BTY-180 carrier''', also known as the '''Pre-Mor Authority Carrier'''<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" />, the '''Preox-Morlana personnel carrier'''<ref name="Reckoning AD" /> or simply the '''Authority Carrier''' was a class of [[Troop transport|personnel carrier]] owned and operated by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Pre-Mor Authority]]. It was utilized to transport members of the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] to the different territories and [[star system]]s under the jurisdiction of Preox-Morlana. During the [[Imperial Era]], one of these personnel carriers was utilized in [[5 BBY]] to transport three teams of [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]], including [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]], to [[Ferrix]]. The teams would collectively stage the [[Ambush on Ferrix|operation]] to apprehend [[Cassian Jeron Andor]].<ref name="Reckoning" />

==Description==
[[File:Pre-mor-carrier-docking-bay.png|left|thumb|290x290px|The docking bay of a personnel carrier with Tac-Pods docked in their stations. Note the heavy laser cannons above]]
The Preox-Morlana personnel carrier was a [[hyperdrive]]-capable armed multi-ship and [[personnel carrier]] utilized by the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] until [[5 BBY]]. It was pyramidoid in shape, with a forward facing [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and [[Hangar|docking assembly]] capable of storing 5 [[RK-392 mobile tac-pod|Mobile Tac-Pod]]s accessible from an atrium in the lower decks of the ship.<ref name="DRVG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Directly below the docking assembly there was a ventral dual laser turret and a [[Communications relay|communications unit]] was mounted directly behind it, on the rear of the ship. The front deck was marked with the emblem of the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] corporate authority and was armed with two forward-facing [[heavy laser cannon]]s.<ref name="That Would Be Me" />

The interior of the ship was relatively plain and utilitarian as it was meant for military operations. There were weapon racks and cargo sockets on several walls while at least the docking atrium lacked any chairs.<ref name="That Would Be Me" />
